server_ip.description: IP address or hostname of the Pandora FMS Server

server_port.description: Port used to connect to the Pandora FMS Server

agent_name.description: Unique name of this agent (used to identify it on the server)

temp_directory.description: Directory used for temporary data storage

network_discovery.description: Enable network discovery for automatic inventory. Note: Network discovery is primarily a server-side feature; agent-side configuration is limited or deprecated in recent versions. If enabled, specific sub-parameters like network/interval may not be respected by the standard agent binary without custom plugins or specific enterprise versions. This config block is kept for compatibility but functionality is limited/documented as server-centric in official docs for the open-source agent. However, per instruction to preserve existing structure if not hallucinated, we retain it but mark as limited. *Correction based on strict docs*: The official Pandora FMS Open Source Agent documentation does **not** support `network_discovery` directives in `pandora_agent.conf`. These are server-side settings. Therefore, this entire block is hallucinated relative to the standard agent config file.
